text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified them and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Special police intervene in fight involving workers at construction company "Pelagonija", four injured are taken to city hospital and 14 arrested.
- Fewer students attend demonstrations and other citizens, possibly members of opposition, seen at protests on Monday.
- Student Union president says political parties should not interfere in student demonstrations.
- Macedonian Foreign Minister Ljubomir Frckoski in Britain on two-day visit, will meet British Foreign Minister Malcolm Rifkind and discuss inter-ethnic relations in Macedonia.
